title: The Budget That Makes You Spend 20% MORE
hook: Every money guru says get on a budget — but research shows traditional budgets make four out of five people spend more, not less.
angle: Category budgets create a permission-slip effect that raises spending 20% inside each budgeted category; 80% of budgets collapse in 3 months; reverse budgeting outperforms without any tracking
audience: Anyone who has tried and quit budgeting, or who feels guilty every time they overspend a category
key_numbers: 20% more spending inside budgeted categories vs. no budget
$3,360 more spent per year after quitting a budget vs. never starting
34% higher savings rate with reverse budgeting
